description: A tight roll of greyed linen, clean enough to bind a wound.
A small stoppered clay vial of thick, bitter-smelling ointment.
A coil of hemp rope, stiff with old damp but sound.
A pitch-soaked torch, its wrapped head black and unlit.
A short iron bar, flattened and bent at one end.
A slim leather roll of bent picks and tension wires.
